_README: Every image published on this site has an entry here. No entry, no publish.
The legal gate in tools/gates.mjs reads this file and blocks a ready post
that references an image it does not cover.
licence   Required. 'Own work' for anything we made, otherwise the exact
licence name, e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0'. Never a placeholder.
creator   Required. Who made it. 'KRAIL' for our own work.
source    Required unless licence is 'Own work'. URL of the original.
licenceUrl Required for any Creative Commons licence. Link to the deed.
modified  What we changed. Required by the SA licences, useful anyway.
If we cannot fill this in truthfully, we do not use the image.
